import React, { useRef } from "react";

export interface LiquidGlassProps {
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  /**
   * Visual preset variant:
   * - 'capsule': Rounded-full floating pill / toolbar dock
   * - 'card': Rounded-2xl / rounded-3xl content card / modal pane
   * - 'sidebar': Edge-anchored translucent navigation panel
   */
  variant?: "capsule" | "card" | "sidebar";
  /**
   * Material density / blur intensity:
   * - 'light': Subtle sheer frosting (backdrop-blur-md)
   * - 'regular': Apple standard Liquid Glass (backdrop-blur-xl, saturate-180%)
   * - 'thick': Heavy frosted glass for high-contrast backdrops (backdrop-blur-2xl)
   */
  intensity?: "light" | "regular" | "thick";
  /**
   * Enable dynamic pointer-tracking refractive specular highlight
   */
  interactive?: boolean;
  /**
   * Enable subtle 3D tilt transformation on pointer move
   */
  enableTilt?: boolean;
  /**
   * Max tilt degrees (default 4)
   */
  maxTilt?: number;
  /**
   * Custom specular glare opacity (0 - 1, default 0.35)
   */
  glareOpacity?: number;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  onClick?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
}

export const LiquidGlass: React.FC<LiquidGlassProps> = ({
  children,
  variant = "card",
  intensity = "regular",
  interactive = true,
  enableTilt = false,
  maxTilt = 4,
  glareOpacity = 0.35,
  className = "",
  style,
  onClick,
}) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const glareRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!interactive && !enableTilt) return;
    const el = containerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect.width || !rect.height || rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return;

    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    const gxPercent = ((x / rect.width) * 100).toFixed(1);
    const gyPercent = ((y / rect.height) * 100).toFixed(1);

    if (interactive && glareRef.current) {
      glareRef.current.style.opacity = glareOpacity.toString();
      glareRef.current.style.background = `radial-gradient(circle at ${gxPercent}% ${gyPercent}%, rgba(255,255,255,0.8) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 35%, transparent 65%)`;
    }

    if (enableTilt && variant !== "sidebar") {
      const centerX = rect.width / 2;
      const centerY = rect.height / 2;
      const ry = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * maxTilt;
      const rx = -((y - centerY) / centerY) * maxTilt;
      el.style.transform = `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rx.toFixed(2)}deg) rotateY(${ry.toFixed(2)}deg) translateY(-1px)`;
      el.style.transition = "transform 0.1s ease-out";
    }
  };

  const handlePointerLeave = () => {
    if (glareRef.current) {
      glareRef.current.style.opacity = "0";
    }
    const el = containerRef.current;
    if (el) {
      el.style.transform = "";
      el.style.transition = "transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)";
    }
  };

  // Variant geometry
  const variantClasses = {
    capsule: "rounded-full px-5 py-2.5 inline-flex items-center",
    card: "rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl p-6 block",
    sidebar: "rounded-none border-r h-full block",
  }[variant];

  // Material blur & vibrancy density
  const intensityClasses = {
    light: "backdrop-blur-md backdrop-saturate-150",
    regular: "backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-[180%]",
    thick: "backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-[200%]",
  }[intensity];

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
      onPointerLeave={handlePointerLeave}
      onClick={onClick}
      style={style}
      className={`liquid-glass-pane group relative overflow-hidden text-[#1d1d1f] dark:text-[#f5f5f7] select-none transition-all duration-300 ${variantClasses} ${intensityClasses}
        bg-white/65 dark:bg-[#16181d]/65
        contrast-more:bg-white contrast-more:dark:bg-[#16181d] contrast-more:backdrop-blur-none
        motion-reduce:transform-none motion-reduce:transition-none
        border border-white/50 dark:border-white/10
        shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.7),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.06),0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]
        dark:shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.18),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.4),0_12px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.35)]
        hover:shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.85),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_14px_44px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]
        dark:hover:shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.25),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.45),0_16px_48px_rgba(0,0,0,0.45)]
        ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Specular refractive rim caustics sheen layer */}
      {interactive && (
        <div
          ref={glareRef}
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="liquid-glass-glare pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-300"
          style={{
            mixBlendMode: "overlay",
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Micro-frost edge reflection ring */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 rounded-[inherit] ring-1 ring-inset ring-white/30 dark:ring-white/10"
      />

      {/* Content wrapper */}
      <div className="relative z-0 h-full w-full">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================
File: react/MessageActionToolbar.tsx
================================================================

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Copy, Check, RotateCcw, ThumbsUp, ThumbsDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "./UiIcon";

export interface MessageActionToolbarProps {
  content: string;
  role?: "assistant" | "user" | string;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  onFeedback?: (type: "up" | "down") => void;
  branchIndex?: number;
  totalBranches?: number;
  onBranchChange?: (nextIndex: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const MessageActionToolbar: React.FC<MessageActionToolbarProps> = ({
  content,
  role = "assistant",
  onRetry,
  onFeedback,
  branchIndex,
  totalBranches,
  onBranchChange,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<"up" | "down" | null>(null);

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(content);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleThumb = (type: "up" | "down") => {
    const next = feedback === type ? null : type;
    setFeedback(next);
    if (onFeedback && next) onFeedback(next);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 text-xs mt-1.5 select-none ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Branch Navigator (if multiple versions exist) */}
      {totalBranches && totalBranches > 1 && branchIndex !== undefined && onBranchChange && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 mr-2 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={branchIndex <= 0}
            onClick={() => onBranchChange(branchIndex - 1)}
            className="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5"
            title="Previous version"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
          <span>
            {branchIndex + 1}/{totalBranches}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={branchIndex >= totalBranches - 1}
            onClick={() => onBranchChange(branchIndex + 1)}
            className="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5"
            title="Next version"
          >
            <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Copy */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleCopy}
        className="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors"
        title="Copy response"
      >
        {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
      </button>

      {/* Retry / Regenerate */}
      {onRetry && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRetry}
          className="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors"
          title="Regenerate response"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </button>
      )}

      {/* Thumbs Up / Down */}
      {role === "assistant" && (
        <>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleThumb("up")}
            className={`p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors ${
              feedback === "up" ? "text-blue-500" : "hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
            }`}
            title="Good response"
          >
            <ThumbsUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleThumb("down")}
            className={`p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors ${
              feedback === "down" ? "text-rose-500" : "hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
            }`}
            title="Bad response"
          >
            <ThumbsDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================
File: react/ModelSelector.tsx

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ModelOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  provider?: string;
  description?: string;
  contextLength?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  isDefault?: boolean;
}

export interface ModelSelectorProps {
  models: ModelOption[];
  selectedId: string;
  onSelect?: (model: ModelOption) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  showSearch?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const ModelSelector: React.FC<ModelSelectorProps> = ({
  models = [],
  selectedId,
  onSelect,
  placeholder = "Select model...",
  showSearch = true,
  disabled = false,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const selectedModel = useMemo(
    () => models.find((m) => m.id === selectedId) || null,
    [models, selectedId]
  );

  const filteredModels = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return models;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return models.filter(
      (m) =>
        m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (m.provider && m.provider.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (m.description && m.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (m.tags && m.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q)))
    );
  }, [models, searchQuery]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (
        containerRef.current &&
        !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)
      ) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleSelect = (model: ModelOption) => {
    onSelect?.(model);
    setIsOpen(false);
    setSearchQuery("");
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={`relative inline-block text-xs font-sans text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 ${className}`}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-900/90 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 transition-all shadow-sm ${
          disabled ? "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed" : "cursor-pointer"
        }`}
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          <div className="p-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 shrink-0">
            <UiIcon name="sparkles" size={14} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col text-left truncate">
            <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 truncate">
              {selectedModel ? selectedModel.name : placeholder}
            </span>
            {selectedModel?.provider && (
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                {selectedModel.provider}
                {selectedModel.contextLength ? ` · ${selectedModel.contextLength}` : ""}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <UiIcon
          name="chevron-down"
          size={14}
          className={`text-zinc-400 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 ${
            isOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""
          }`}
        />
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 mt-1.5 w-72 max-h-80 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl z-40 flex flex-col animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
          {showSearch && (
            <div className="p-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100/80 dark:bg-zinc-800/80">
                <UiIcon name="search" size={13} className="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search models..."
                  className="w-full bg-transparent border-none text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
                  autoFocus
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="overflow-y-auto p-1.5 space-y-1 max-h-60" role="listbox">
            {filteredModels.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-3 text-center text-zinc-400 text-xs">No models found</div>
            ) : (
              filteredModels.map((model) => {
                const isSelected = model.id === selectedId;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={model.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSelect(model)}
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={isSelected}
                    className={`w-full flex items-start justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg text-left transition-colors ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100"
                        : "hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate">
                          {model.name}
                        </span>
                        {model.contextLength && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/60 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300 font-mono">
                            {model.contextLength}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {model.tags?.map((tag) => (
                          <span
                            key={tag}
                            className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-medium bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800/50"
                          >
                            {tag}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>

                      {model.description && (
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 truncate mt-0.5">
                          {model.description}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {isSelected && (
                      <UiIcon
                        name="check"
                        size={14}
                        className="text-emerald-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                      />
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
export default ModelSelector;

File: react/PointerRipples.tsx
================================================================

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

/**
 * PointerRipples — React
 * WebGL-powered interactive multi-color fluid ripples backdrop.
 * Follows mouse/pointer movement with Navier-Stokes fluid dynamics,
 * rainbow hue-shifting dye splats, vorticity swirls, and 3D diffuse shading.
 * 
 * Features:
 * - Fluid simulation (advection, divergence, pressure Poisson solver, vorticity confinement)
 * - Coalesced pointer event handling for high-refresh-rate cursor tracking
 * - Idle sleep & visibilitychange hibernation for zero idle CPU/GPU consumption
 * - WebGL2 & WebGL1 fallback with half-float/float FBO support
 * - prefers-reduced-motion accessibility compliance
 */

export interface PointerRipplesProps {
  /** Simulation resolution grid (default 128) */
  simResolution?: number;
  /** Dye texture resolution (default 768) */
  dyeResolution?: number;
  /** Rate at which dye dissipates/fades (default 2.4) */
  densityDissipation?: number;
  /** Rate at which fluid velocity slows down (default 1.6) */
  velocityDissipation?: number;
  /** Pressure coefficient (default 0.8) */
  pressure?: number;
  /** Number of Jacobi iterations for pressure solver (default 20) */
  pressureIterations?: number;
  /** Fluid vorticity / curl strength (default 13) */
  curl?: number;
  /** Splat radius relative to canvas (default 0.24) */
  splatRadius?: number;
  /** Force exerted by pointer velocity (default 4800) */
  splatForce?: number;
  /** Enable 3D diffuse lighting & shading on dye surfaces (default true) */
  shading?: boolean;
  /** Speed of continuous hue rotation per second (default 0.055) */
  colorSpeed?: number;
  /** Hue shift step per pointer trail point (default 0.012) */
  colorStep?: number;
  /** Dye color saturation [0-1] (default 0.72) */
  colorSaturation?: number;
  /** Dye color brightness [0-1] (default 1.0) */
  colorValue?: number;
  /** Dye color opacity / intensity multiplier (default 0.26) */
  colorIntensity?: number;
  /** Milliseconds of pointer inactivity before pausing RAF loop (default 4000) */
  idleMs?: number;
  /** Maximum device pixel ratio cap (default 1.5) */
  maxPixelRatio?: number;
  /** Custom canvas CSS classes */
  className?: string;
  /** Custom canvas inline styles */
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  /** Overall opacity (default 0.58) */
  opacity?: number;
}

const BASE_VERTEX_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
attribute vec2 aPosition;
varying vec2 vUv;
varying vec2 vL;
varying vec2 vR;
varying vec2 vT;
varying vec2 vB;
uniform vec2 texelSize;

void main () {
  vUv = aPosition * 0.5 + 0.5;
  vL = vUv - vec2(texelSize.x, 0.0);
  vR = vUv + vec2(texelSize.x, 0.0);
  vT = vUv + vec2(0.0, texelSize.y);
  vB = vUv - vec2(0.0, texelSize.y);
  gl_Position = vec4(aPosition, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const CLEAR_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vUv;
uniform sampler2D uTexture;
uniform float value;

void main () {
  gl_FragColor = value * texture2D(uTexture, vUv);
}
`;

const SPLAT_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
precision highp sampler2D;
varying vec2 vUv;
uniform sampler2D uTarget;
uniform float aspectRatio;
uniform vec3 color;
uniform vec2 point;
uniform float radius;

void main () {
  vec2 offset = vUv - point;
  offset.x *= aspectRatio;
  vec3 splat = exp(-dot(offset, offset) / radius) * color;
  vec3 base = texture2D(uTarget, vUv).xyz;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(base + splat, 1.0);
}
`;

const ADVECTION_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
precision highp sampler2D;
varying vec2 vUv;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;
uniform sampler2D uSource;
uniform vec2 texelSize;
uniform vec2 dyeTexelSize;
uniform float dt;
uniform float dissipation;

vec4 bilerp (sampler2D source, vec2 uv, vec2 size) {
  vec2 coord = uv / size - 0.5;
  vec2 index = floor(coord);
  vec2 weight = fract(coord);
  vec4 a = texture2D(source, (index + vec2(0.5, 0.5)) * size);
  vec4 b = texture2D(source, (index + vec2(1.5, 0.5)) * size);
  vec4 c = texture2D(source, (index + vec2(0.5, 1.5)) * size);
  vec4 d = texture2D(source, (index + vec2(1.5, 1.5)) * size);
  return mix(mix(a, b, weight.x), mix(c, d, weight.x), weight.y);
}

void main () {
#ifdef MANUAL_FILTERING
  vec2 coord = vUv - dt * bilerp(uVelocity, vUv, texelSize).xy * texelSize;
  vec4 result = bilerp(uSource, coord, dyeTexelSize);
#else
  vec2 coord = vUv - dt * texture2D(uVelocity, vUv).xy * texelSize;
  vec4 result = texture2D(uSource, coord);
#endif
  gl_FragColor = result / (1.0 + dissipation * dt);
}
`;

const DIVERGENCE_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vUv;
varying highp vec2 vL;
varying highp vec2 vR;
varying highp vec2 vT;
varying highp vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uVelocity, vL).x;
  float right = texture2D(uVelocity, vR).x;
  float top = texture2D(uVelocity, vT).y;
  float bottom = texture2D(uVelocity, vB).y;
  vec2 center = texture2D(uVelocity, vUv).xy;

  if (vL.x < 0.0) left = -center.x;
  if (vR.x > 1.0) right = -center.x;
  if (vT.y > 1.0) top = -center.y;
  if (vB.y < 0.0) bottom = -center.y;

  float divergence = 0.5 * (right - left + top - bottom);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(divergence, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const CURL_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vL;
varying highp vec2 vR;
varying highp vec2 vT;
varying highp vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uVelocity, vL).y;
  float right = texture2D(uVelocity, vR).y;
  float top = texture2D(uVelocity, vT).x;
  float bottom = texture2D(uVelocity, vB).x;
  float value = right - left - top + bottom;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(0.5 * value, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const VORTICITY_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
precision highp sampler2D;
varying vec2 vUv;
varying vec2 vL;
varying vec2 vR;
varying vec2 vT;
varying vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;
uniform sampler2D uCurl;
uniform float curl;
uniform float dt;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uCurl, vL).x;
  float right = texture2D(uCurl, vR).x;
  float top = texture2D(uCurl, vT).x;
  float bottom = texture2D(uCurl, vB).x;
  float center = texture2D(uCurl, vUv).x;
  vec2 force = 0.5 * vec2(abs(top) - abs(bottom), abs(right) - abs(left));
  force /= length(force) + 0.0001;
  force *= curl * center;
  force.y *= -1.0;

  vec2 velocity = texture2D(uVelocity, vUv).xy;
  velocity += force * dt;
  velocity = clamp(velocity, -1000.0, 1000.0);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(velocity, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const PRESSURE_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vUv;
varying highp vec2 vL;
varying highp vec2 vR;
varying highp vec2 vT;
varying highp vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uPressure;
uniform sampler2D uDivergence;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uPressure, vL).x;
  float right = texture2D(uPressure, vR).x;
  float top = texture2D(uPressure, vT).x;
  float bottom = texture2D(uPressure, vB).x;
  float divergence = texture2D(uDivergence, vUv).x;
  float pressure = (left + right + bottom + top - divergence) * 0.25;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(pressure, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const GRADIENT_SUBTRACT_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vUv;
varying highp vec2 vL;
varying highp vec2 vR;
varying highp vec2 vT;
varying highp vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uPressure;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uPressure, vL).x;
  float right = texture2D(uPressure, vR).x;
  float top = texture2D(uPressure, vT).x;
  float bottom = texture2D(uPressure, vB).x;
  vec2 velocity = texture2D(uVelocity, vUv).xy;
  velocity -= vec2(right - left, top - bottom);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(velocity, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const DISPLAY_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
precision highp sampler2D;
varying vec2 vUv;
varying vec2 vL;
varying vec2 vR;
varying vec2 vT;
varying vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uTexture;
uniform vec2 texelSize;

vec3 linearToGamma (vec3 color) {
  color = max(color, vec3(0.0));
  return max(1.055 * pow(color, vec3(0.416666667)) - 0.055, vec3(0.0));
}

void main () {
  vec3 color = texture2D(uTexture, vUv).rgb;

#ifdef SHADING
  vec3 left = texture2D(uTexture, vL).rgb;
  vec3 right = texture2D(uTexture, vR).rgb;
  vec3 top = texture2D(uTexture, vT).rgb;
  vec3 bottom = texture2D(uTexture, vB).rgb;
  float dx = length(right) - length(left);
  float dy = length(top) - length(bottom);
  vec3 normal = normalize(vec3(dx, dy, length(texelSize) * 3.0));
  float diffuse = clamp(dot(normal, vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)) + 0.85, 0.85, 1.0);
  color *= diffuse;
#endif

  float peak = max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b));
  color = min(linearToGamma(color), vec3(1.0));
  float alpha = clamp(peak * 1.35, 0.0, 1.0);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(color, alpha);
}
`;

function normalizeHue(h: number): number {
  return ((h % 1) + 1) % 1;
}

function clamp(val: number, min = 0, max = 1): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, val));
}

function hsvToRgb(h: number, s: number, v: number): { r: number; g: number; b: number } {
  const i = Math.floor(h * 6);
  const f = h * 6 - i;
  const p = v * (1 - s);
  const q = v * (1 - f * s);
  const t = v * (1 - (1 - f) * s);
  switch (i % 6) {
    case 0:
      return { r: v, g: t, b: p };
    case 1:
      return { r: q, g: v, b: p };
    case 2:
      return { r: p, g: v, b: t };
    case 3:
      return { r: p, g: q, b: v };
    case 4:
      return { r: t, g: p, b: v };
    default:
      return { r: v, g: p, b: q };
  }
}

interface FBO {
  texture: WebGLTexture;
  raw: WebGLFramebuffer;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  texelX: number;
  texelY: number;
}

interface DoubleFBO {
  read: FBO;
  write: FBO;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  texelX: number;
  texelY: number;
  swap: () => void;
}

interface ProgramInfo {
  raw: WebGLProgram;
  uniforms: Record<string, WebGLUniformLocation | null>;
}

interface PointerInput {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  color: { r: number; g: number; b: number };
  radius?: number;
}

class FluidSimulationEngine {
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;
  cfg: Required<Omit<PointerRipplesProps, "className" | "style" | "opacity">>;
  view: Window;
  gl: WebGLRenderingContext | WebGL2RenderingContext;
  isGl2: boolean;
  textures = new Set<WebGLTexture>();
  fbos = new Set<WebGLFramebuffer>();
  programs = new Set<WebGLProgram>();
  shaders = new Set<WebGLShader>();
  buffers = new Set<WebGLBuffer>();
  inputs: PointerInput[] = [];
  linear = false;
  texType = 0;
  rgba = { internal: 0, format: 0 };
  rg = { internal: 0, format: 0 };
  r = { internal: 0, format: 0 };
  prog: Record<string, ProgramInfo> | null = null;
  dye: DoubleFBO | null = null;
  velocity: DoubleFBO | null = null;
  divergence: FBO | null = null;
  curlFbo: FBO | null = null;
  pressure: DoubleFBO | null = null;
  frame = 0;
  lastTime = 0;
  lastInput = 0;
  hue = 0.52;
  pointer: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;
  visible = true;
  active = false;
  dead = false;

  constructor(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, options: PointerRipplesProps) {
    this.canvas = canvas;
    this.cfg = {
      simResolution: options.simResolution ?? 128,
      dyeResolution: options.dyeResolution ?? 768,
      densityDissipation: options.densityDissipation ?? 2.4,
      velocityDissipation: options.velocityDissipation ?? 1.6,
      pressure: options.pressure ?? 0.8,
      pressureIterations: options.pressureIterations ?? 20,
      curl: options.curl ?? 13,
      splatRadius: options.splatRadius ?? 0.24,
      splatForce: options.splatForce ?? 4800,
      shading: options.shading ?? true,
      colorSpeed: options.colorSpeed ?? 0.055,
      colorStep: options.colorStep ?? 0.012,
      colorSaturation: options.colorSaturation ?? 0.72,
      colorValue: options.colorValue ?? 1.0,
      colorIntensity: options.colorIntensity ?? 0.26,
      idleMs: options.idleMs ?? 4000,
      maxPixelRatio: options.maxPixelRatio ?? 1.5,
    };
    this.view = canvas.ownerDocument.defaultView ?? window;

    const ctxAttr: WebGLContextAttributes = {
      alpha: true,
      depth: false,
      stencil: false,
      antialias: false,
      premultipliedAlpha: true,
      preserveDrawingBuffer: false,
    };

    const gl2 = canvas.getContext("webgl2", ctxAttr);
    const gl1 = gl2 ? null : (canvas.getContext("webgl", ctxAttr) as WebGLRenderingContext | null);
    const gl = gl2 ?? gl1;
    if (!gl) throw new Error("WebGL is unavailable");

    this.gl = gl;
    this.isGl2 = !!gl2;

    try {
      this.initFormats();
      this.initPrograms();
      this.initQuad();
      this.resizeCanvas();
      this.initFramebuffers();
      this.clearScreen();
    } catch (err) {
      this.releaseGl();
      throw err;
    }
  }

  update = (now: number) => {
    this.frame = 0;
    if (this.dead || !this.visible) return;

    if (now - this.lastInput >= this.cfg.idleMs && this.inputs.length === 0) {
      this.active = false;
      this.clearAll();
      return;
    }

    const dt = Math.min(Math.max((now - this.lastTime) / 1000, 0.001), 1 / 60);
    this.lastTime = now;
    this.hue = normalizeHue(this.hue + dt * this.cfg.colorSpeed);

    if (this.resizeCanvas()) {
      this.initFramebuffers();
    }

    this.applyInputs();
    this.step(dt);
    this.render();
    this.frame = this.view.requestAnimationFrame(this.update);
  };

  move(clientX: number, clientY: number) {
    if (this.dead || !this.visible) return;
    const pt = this.toPoint(clientX, clientY);
    const prev = this.pointer;
    this.pointer = pt;

    if (!prev) {
      this.queue({ ...pt, vx: 0, vy: 0, color: this.nextColor() });
      this.wake();
      return;
    }

    const w = Math.max(this.canvas.clientWidth, 1);
    const h = Math.max(this.canvas.clientHeight, 1);
    const dx = (pt.x - prev.x) * w;
    const dy = (pt.y - prev.y) * h;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const count = clamp(Math.ceil(dist / 14), 1, 32);

    const vx = this.correctX((pt.x - prev.x) / count) * this.cfg.splatForce;
    const vy = this.correctY((pt.y - prev.y) / count) * this.cfg.splatForce;

    for (let i = 1; i <= count; i += 1) {
      const t = i / count;
      this.queue({
        x: prev.x + (pt.x - prev.x) * t,
        y: prev.y + (pt.y - prev.y) * t,
        vx,
        vy,
        color: this.nextColor(),
      });
    }
    this.wake();
  }

  splat(clientX: number, clientY: number) {
    if (this.dead || !this.visible) return;
    const pt = this.toPoint(clientX, clientY);
    const hue = this.hue;
    const spread = Math.min(this.canvas.clientWidth, this.canvas.clientHeight) * 0.1;

    this.pointer = pt;
    this.queue({
      ...pt,
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
      color: this.makeColor(hue, 1.4),
      radius: 0.19,
    });

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += 1) {
      const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2;
      const subPt = this.toPoint(
        clientX + Math.cos(angle) * spread,
        clientY + Math.sin(angle) * spread
      );
      this.queue({
        ...subPt,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * 140,
        vy: -Math.sin(angle) * 140,
        color: this.makeColor(hue + i / 6, 1.7),
        radius: 0.11,
      });
    }

    this.hue = normalizeHue(hue + this.cfg.colorStep * 7);
    this.wake();
  }

  resize() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    if (this.resizeCanvas()) {
      this.initFramebuffers();
      if (!this.active) this.clearScreen();
    }
  }

  setVisible(visible: boolean) {
    if (this.dead || visible === this.visible) return;
    this.visible = visible;
    this.pointer = null;
    if (!visible) {
      this.inputs.length = 0;
      this.stop();
      this.clearAll();
      return;
    }
    this.active = false;
    this.clearScreen();
  }

  destroy() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    this.dead = true;
    this.stop();
    this.inputs.length = 0;
    this.pointer = null;
    this.clearScreen();
    this.releaseGl();
  }

  private initFormats() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    if (this.isGl2) {
      const gl2 = gl as WebGL2RenderingContext;
      gl2.getExtension("EXT_color_buffer_float");
      this.linear = !!gl2.getExtension("OES_texture_float_linear");
      this.texType = gl2.HALF_FLOAT;

      const rgba = this.supportedFormat(gl2.RGBA16F, gl2.RGBA, this.texType);
      const rg = this.supportedFormat(gl2.RG16F, gl2.RG, this.texType);
      const r = this.supportedFormat(gl2.R16F, gl2.RED, this.texType);

      if (rgba && rg && r) {
        this.rgba = rgba;
        this.rg = rg;
        this.r = r;
        return;
      }
    }

    const halfExt = gl.getExtension("OES_texture_half_float");
    const halfLinear = gl.getExtension("OES_texture_half_float_linear");
    const floatExt = gl.getExtension("OES_texture_float");
    const floatLinear = gl.getExtension("OES_texture_float_linear");

    const candidates = [
      halfExt && { type: (halfExt as any).HALF_FLOAT_OES, linear: !!halfLinear },
      floatExt && { type: gl.FLOAT, linear: !!floatLinear },
    ].filter(Boolean) as { type: number; linear: boolean }[];

    for (const cand of candidates) {
      const fmt = this.supportedFormat(gl.RGBA, gl.RGBA, cand.type);
      if (fmt) {
        this.texType = cand.type;
        this.linear = cand.linear;
        this.rgba = fmt;
        this.rg = fmt;
        this.r = fmt;
        return;
      }
    }

    throw new Error("WebGL floating-point framebuffers are unavailable");
  }

  private supportedFormat(
    internal: number,
    format: number,
    type: number
  ): { internal: number; format: number } | null {
    if (this.isRenderable(internal, format, type)) {
      return { internal, format };
    }
    if (!this.isGl2) return null;
    const gl2 = this.gl as WebGL2RenderingContext;
    if (internal === gl2.R16F) return this.supportedFormat(gl2.RG16F, gl2.RG, type);
    if (internal === gl2.RG16F) return this.supportedFormat(gl2.RGBA16F, gl2.RGBA, type);
    return null;
  }

  private isRenderable(internal: number, format: number, type: number): boolean {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const tex = gl.createTexture();
    const fbo = gl.createFramebuffer();
    if (!tex || !fbo) return false;

    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.NEAREST);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.NEAREST);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, internal, 4, 4, 0, format, type, null);

    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);
    gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex, 0);
    const ok = gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER) === gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE;

    gl.deleteTexture(tex);
    gl.deleteFramebuffer(fbo);
    return ok;
  }

  private initPrograms() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const vert = this.compileShader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, BASE_VERTEX_SHADER);

    const makeProg = (fragSrc: string, defs: string[] = []): ProgramInfo => {
      const frag = this.compileShader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragSrc, defs);
      return this.linkProgram(vert, frag);
    };

    const advectionDefs = this.linear ? [] : ["MANUAL_FILTERING"];
    const displayDefs = this.cfg.shading && this.linear ? ["SHADING"] : [];

    this.prog = {
      clear: makeProg(CLEAR_SHADER),
      splat: makeProg(SPLAT_SHADER),
      advection: makeProg(ADVECTION_SHADER, advectionDefs),
      divergence: makeProg(DIVERGENCE_SHADER),
      curl: makeProg(CURL_SHADER),
      vorticity: makeProg(VORTICITY_SHADER),
      pressure: makeProg(PRESSURE_SHADER),
      gradient: makeProg(GRADIENT_SUBTRACT_SHADER),
      display: makeProg(DISPLAY_SHADER, displayDefs),
    };
  }

  private compileShader(type: number, src: string, defs: string[] = []): WebGLShader {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const shader = gl.createShader(type);
    if (!shader) throw new Error("Failed to create WebGL shader");
    this.shaders.add(shader);

    const prefix = defs.map((d) => `#define ${d}\n`).join("");
    gl.shaderSource(shader, `${prefix}${src}`);
    gl.compileShader(shader);

    if (!gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
      const err = gl.getShaderInfoLog(shader) || "Shader compile error";
      gl.deleteShader(shader);
      this.shaders.delete(shader);
      throw new Error(err);
    }
    return shader;
  }

  private linkProgram(vert: WebGLShader, frag: WebGLShader): ProgramInfo {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const prog = gl.createProgram();
    if (!prog) throw new Error("Failed to create WebGL program");
    this.programs.add(prog);

    gl.attachShader(prog, vert);
    gl.attachShader(prog, frag);
    gl.bindAttribLocation(prog, 0, "aPosition");
    gl.linkProgram(prog);

    if (!gl.getProgramParameter(prog, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
      const err = gl.getProgramInfoLog(prog) || "Program link error";
      gl.deleteProgram(prog);
      this.programs.delete(prog);
      throw new Error(err);
    }

    const uniforms: Record<string, WebGLUniformLocation | null> = {};
    const count = gl.getProgramParameter(prog, gl.ACTIVE_UNIFORMS);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
      const info = gl.getActiveUniform(prog, i);
      if (info) uniforms[info.name] = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, info.name);
    }
    return { raw: prog, uniforms };
  }

  private initQuad() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const vbo = gl.createBuffer();
    const ibo = gl.createBuffer();
    if (!vbo || !ibo) throw new Error("Failed to create geometry buffers");

    this.buffers.add(vbo);
    this.buffers.add(ibo);

    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, vbo);
    gl.bufferData(
      gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,
      new Float32Array([-1, -1, -1, 1, 1, 1, 1, -1]),
      gl.STATIC_DRAW
    );

    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, ibo);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, new Uint16Array([0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);

    gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
  }

  private initFramebuffers() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    this.releaseTargets();

    const simRes = this.calcResolution(this.cfg.simResolution);
    const dyeRes = this.calcResolution(this.linear ? this.cfg.dyeResolution : 256);
    const filter = this.linear ? gl.LINEAR : gl.NEAREST;

    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    this.dye = this.createDoubleFbo(dyeRes.width, dyeRes.height, this.rgba, filter);
    this.velocity = this.createDoubleFbo(simRes.width, simRes.height, this.rg, filter);
    this.divergence = this.createFbo(simRes.width, simRes.height, this.r, gl.NEAREST);
    this.curlFbo = this.createFbo(simRes.width, simRes.height, this.r, gl.NEAREST);
    this.pressure = this.createDoubleFbo(simRes.width, simRes.height, this.r, gl.NEAREST);
  }

  private createFbo(w: number, h: number, fmt: { internal: number; format: number }, filter: number): FBO {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const tex = gl.createTexture();
    const fbo = gl.createFramebuffer();
    if (!tex || !fbo) throw new Error("Failed to create FBO");

    this.textures.add(tex);
    this.fbos.add(fbo);

    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, filter);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, filter);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, fmt.internal, w, h, 0, fmt.format, this.texType, null);

    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);
    gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex, 0);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, w, h);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
    gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);

    return {
      texture: tex,
      raw: fbo,
      width: w,
      height: h,
      texelX: 1 / w,
      texelY: 1 / h,
    };
  }

  private createDoubleFbo(
    w: number,
    h: number,
    fmt: { internal: number; format: number },
    filter: number
  ): DoubleFBO {
    const read = this.createFbo(w, h, fmt, filter);
    const write = this.createFbo(w, h, fmt, filter);
    const dfbo: DoubleFBO = {
      read,
      write,
      width: w,
      height: h,
      texelX: 1 / w,
      texelY: 1 / h,
      swap: () => {
        const tmp = dfbo.read;
        dfbo.read = dfbo.write;
        dfbo.write = tmp;
      },
    };
    return dfbo;
  }

  private releaseTargets() {
    if (this.divergence) this.deleteFbo(this.divergence);
    if (this.curlFbo) this.deleteFbo(this.curlFbo);
    if (this.dye) {
      this.deleteFbo(this.dye.read);
      this.deleteFbo(this.dye.write);
    }
    if (this.velocity) {
      this.deleteFbo(this.velocity.read);
      this.deleteFbo(this.velocity.write);
    }
    if (this.pressure) {
      this.deleteFbo(this.pressure.read);
      this.deleteFbo(this.pressure.write);
    }
    this.dye = null;
    this.velocity = null;
    this.divergence = null;
    this.curlFbo = null;
    this.pressure = null;
  }

  private deleteFbo(fbo: FBO) {
    this.gl.deleteTexture(fbo.texture);
    this.gl.deleteFramebuffer(fbo.raw);
    this.textures.delete(fbo.texture);
    this.fbos.delete(fbo.raw);
  }

  private calcResolution(res: number): { width: number; height: number } {
    const dw = this.gl.drawingBufferWidth;
    const dh = this.gl.drawingBufferHeight;
    const aspect = Math.max(dw / Math.max(dh, 1), dh / Math.max(dw, 1));
    const small = Math.round(res);
    const big = Math.round(res * aspect);
    return dw > dh ? { width: big, height: small } : { width: small, height: big };
  }

  private resizeCanvas(): boolean {
    const dpr = Math.min(this.view.devicePixelRatio || 1, this.cfg.maxPixelRatio);
    const w = this.canvas.clientWidth || this.canvas.width || 1;
    const h = this.canvas.clientHeight || this.canvas.height || 1;
    const targetW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(w * dpr));
    const targetH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(h * dpr));

    if (this.canvas.width === targetW && this.canvas.height === targetH) {
      return false;
    }
    this.canvas.width = targetW;
    this.canvas.height = targetH;
    return true;
  }

  private toPoint(clientX: number, clientY: number): { x: number; y: number } {
    const rect = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const w = Math.max(rect.width, 1);
    const h = Math.max(rect.height, 1);
    const x = clamp((clientX - rect.left) / w);
    const y = 1 - clamp((clientY - rect.top) / h);
    return { x, y };
  }

  private correctX(val: number): number {
    const aspect = this.canvas.width / Math.max(this.canvas.height, 1);
    return aspect < 1 ? val * aspect : val;
  }

  private correctY(val: number): number {
    const aspect = this.canvas.width / Math.max(this.canvas.height, 1);
    return aspect > 1 ? val / aspect : val;
  }

  private correctRadius(rad: number): number {
    const aspect = this.canvas.width / Math.max(this.canvas.height, 1);
    return aspect > 1 ? rad * aspect : rad;
  }

  private makeColor(hue: number, intensityScale = 1) {
    const rgb = hsvToRgb(normalizeHue(hue), this.cfg.colorSaturation, this.cfg.colorValue);
    const scale = this.cfg.colorIntensity * intensityScale;
    return { r: rgb.r * scale, g: rgb.g * scale, b: rgb.b * scale };
  }

  private nextColor(intensityScale = 1) {
    const col = this.makeColor(this.hue, intensityScale);
    this.hue = normalizeHue(this.hue + this.cfg.colorStep);
    return col;
  }

  private queue(item: PointerInput) {
    if (this.inputs.length >= 128) this.inputs.shift();
    this.inputs.push(item);
  }

  private wake() {
    this.lastInput = this.view.performance.now();
    this.active = true;
    if (!this.frame && this.visible) {
      this.lastTime = this.lastInput;
      this.frame = this.view.requestAnimationFrame(this.update);
    }
  }

  private stop() {
    if (this.frame) {
      this.view.cancelAnimationFrame(this.frame);
      this.frame = 0;
    }
  }

  private applyInputs() {
    const count = Math.min(this.inputs.length, 10);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
      const item = this.inputs.shift();
      if (item) this.applySplat(item);
    }
  }

  private applySplat(item: PointerInput) {
    if (!this.prog || !this.velocity || !this.dye) return;
    const prog = this.prog.splat;
    const gl = this.gl;
    const vel = this.velocity;
    const dye = this.dye;

    this.bindProg(prog);
    this.u1f(prog, "aspectRatio", this.canvas.width / Math.max(this.canvas.height, 1));
    this.u2f(prog, "point", item.x, item.y);
    this.u1f(
      prog,
      "radius",
      this.correctRadius((this.cfg.splatRadius * (item.radius ?? 1)) / 100)
    );

    // Splat velocity
    this.u1i(prog, "uTarget", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.u3f(prog, "color", item.vx, item.vy, 0);
    this.blit(vel.write);
    vel.swap();

    // Splat dye color
    this.u1i(prog, "uTarget", this.attachTex(dye.read, 0));
    this.u3f(prog, "color", item.color.r, item.color.g, item.color.b);
    this.blit(dye.write);
    dye.swap();

    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, null);
  }

  private step(dt: number) {
    if (!this.prog || !this.velocity || !this.pressure || !this.dye || !this.divergence || !this.curlFbo) {
      return;
    }
    const gl = this.gl;
    const prog = this.prog;
    const vel = this.velocity;
    const press = this.pressure;
    const dye = this.dye;
    const div = this.divergence;
    const curl = this.curlFbo;

    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);

    // 1. Curl
    this.bindProg(prog.curl);
    this.u2f(prog.curl, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.curl, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.blit(curl);

    // 2. Vorticity confinement
    this.bindProg(prog.vorticity);
    this.u2f(prog.vorticity, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.vorticity, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.u1i(prog.vorticity, "uCurl", this.attachTex(curl, 1));
    this.u1f(prog.vorticity, "curl", this.cfg.curl);
    this.u1f(prog.vorticity, "dt", dt);
    this.blit(vel.write);
    vel.swap();

    // 3. Divergence
    this.bindProg(prog.divergence);
    this.u2f(prog.divergence, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.divergence, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.blit(div);

    // 4. Clear pressure
    this.bindProg(prog.clear);
    this.u1i(prog.clear, "uTexture", this.attachTex(press.read, 0));
    this.u1f(prog.clear, "value", this.cfg.pressure);
    this.blit(press.write);
    press.swap();

    // 5. Pressure Poisson solve (Jacobi iterations)
    this.bindProg(prog.pressure);
    this.u2f(prog.pressure, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.pressure, "uDivergence", this.attachTex(div, 0));
    for (let i = 0; i < this.cfg.pressureIterations; i += 1) {
      this.u1i(prog.pressure, "uPressure", this.attachTex(press.read, 1));
      this.blit(press.write);
      press.swap();
    }

    // 6. Subtract gradient
    this.bindProg(prog.gradient);
    this.u2f(prog.gradient, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.gradient, "uPressure", this.attachTex(press.read, 0));
    this.u1i(prog.gradient, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 1));
    this.blit(vel.write);
    vel.swap();

    // 7. Advect velocity
    this.bindProg(prog.advection);
    this.u2f(prog.advection, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    if (!this.linear) this.u2f(prog.advection, "dyeTexelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    const velTex = this.attachTex(vel.read, 0);
    this.u1i(prog.advection, "uVelocity", velTex);
    this.u1i(prog.advection, "uSource", velTex);
    this.u1f(prog.advection, "dt", dt);
    this.u1f(prog.advection, "dissipation", this.cfg.velocityDissipation);
    this.blit(vel.write);
    vel.swap();

    // 8. Advect dye
    if (!this.linear) this.u2f(prog.advection, "dyeTexelSize", dye.texelX, dye.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.advection, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.u1i(prog.advection, "uSource", this.attachTex(dye.read, 1));
    this.u1f(prog.advection, "dissipation", this.cfg.densityDissipation);
    this.blit(dye.write);
    dye.swap();
  }

  private render() {
    if (!this.prog || !this.dye) return;
    const gl = this.gl;
    const prog = this.prog.display;
    const dye = this.dye;

    this.clearScreen();
    gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);

    this.bindProg(prog);
    this.u2f(prog, "texelSize", 1 / gl.drawingBufferWidth, 1 / gl.drawingBufferHeight);
    this.u1i(prog, "uTexture", this.attachTex(dye.read, 0));
    this.blit(null);
  }

  private clearAll() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const targets: (FBO | null)[] = [
      this.divergence,
      this.curlFbo,
      this.dye ? this.dye.read : null,
      this.dye ? this.dye.write : null,
      this.velocity ? this.velocity.read : null,
      this.velocity ? this.velocity.write : null,
      this.pressure ? this.pressure.read : null,
      this.pressure ? this.pressure.write : null,
    ];

    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
    for (const t of targets) {
      if (t) {
        gl.viewport(0, 0, t.width, t.height);
        gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, t.raw);
        gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
      }
    }
    this.clearScreen();
  }

  private clearScreen() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    gl.viewport(0, 0, gl.drawingBufferWidth, gl.drawingBufferHeight);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
    gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
  }

  private bindProg(p: ProgramInfo) {
    this.gl.useProgram(p.raw);
  }

  private attachTex(fbo: FBO, slot: number): number {
    const gl = this.gl;
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0 + slot);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, fbo.texture);
    return slot;
  }

  private blit(target: FBO | null) {
    const gl = this.gl;
    if (target) {
      gl.viewport(0, 0, target.width, target.height);
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, target.raw);
    } else {
      gl.viewport(0, 0, gl.drawingBufferWidth, gl.drawingBufferHeight);
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    }
    gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, 6, gl.UNSIGNED_SHORT, 0);
  }

  private u1i(p: ProgramInfo, name: string, val: number) {
    const loc = p.uniforms[name];
    if (loc != null) this.gl.uniform1i(loc, val);
  }

  private u1f(p: ProgramInfo, name: string, val: number) {
    const loc = p.uniforms[name];
    if (loc != null) this.gl.uniform1f(loc, val);
  }

  private u2f(p: ProgramInfo, name: string, x: number, y: number) {
    const loc = p.uniforms[name];
    if (loc != null) this.gl.uniform2f(loc, x, y);
  }

  private u3f(p: ProgramInfo, name: string, x: number, y: number, z: number) {
    const loc = p.uniforms[name];
    if (loc != null) this.gl.uniform3f(loc, x, y, z);
  }

  private releaseGl() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    this.releaseTargets();
    this.textures.forEach((t) => gl.deleteTexture(t));
    this.fbos.forEach((f) => gl.deleteFramebuffer(f));
    this.programs.forEach((p) => gl.deleteProgram(p));
    this.shaders.forEach((s) => gl.deleteShader(s));
    this.buffers.forEach((b) => gl.deleteBuffer(b));
    this.textures.clear();
    this.fbos.clear();
    this.programs.clear();
    this.shaders.clear();
    this.buffers.clear();
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, null);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, null);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, null);
    gl.useProgram(null);
    this.prog = null;
  }
}

export const PointerRipples: React.FC<PointerRipplesProps> = ({
  simResolution = 128,
  dyeResolution = 768,
  densityDissipation = 2.4,
  velocityDissipation = 1.6,
  pressure = 0.8,
  pressureIterations = 20,
  curl = 13,
  splatRadius = 0.24,
  splatForce = 4800,
  shading = true,
  colorSpeed = 0.055,
  colorStep = 0.012,
  colorSaturation = 0.72,
  colorValue = 1.0,
  colorIntensity = 0.26,
  idleMs = 4000,
  maxPixelRatio = 1.5,
  className = "fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none w-full h-full -z-10",
  style,
  opacity = 0.58,
}) => {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || typeof window === "undefined") return;

    // Check accessibility & coarse pointer
    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const coarsePointer = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)");
    if (reduceMotion.matches) return;

    let engine: FluidSimulationEngine | null = null;
    try {
      engine = new FluidSimulationEngine(canvas, {
        simResolution,
        dyeResolution,
        densityDissipation,
        velocityDissipation,
        pressure,
        pressureIterations,
        curl,
        splatRadius,
        splatForce,
        shading,
        colorSpeed,
        colorStep,
        colorSaturation,
        colorValue,
        colorIntensity,
        idleMs,
        maxPixelRatio,
      });
      engine.setVisible(!document.hidden);
    } catch (e) {
      // Graceful fallback when WebGL / float extensions unavailable
      return;
    }

    const onPointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!engine || !e.isPrimary) return;
      const events = (e as any).getCoalescedEvents?.() ?? [e];
      for (const ev of events) {
        engine.move(ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
      }
    };

    const onPointerDown = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!engine || !e.isPrimary) return;
      engine.splat(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    };

    const onResize = () => {
      engine?.resize();
    };

    const onVisibility = () => {
      engine?.setVisible(!document.hidden);
    };

    window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { capture: true, passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown, { capture: true, passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, true);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown, true);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
      engine?.destroy();
      engine = null;
    };
  }, [
    simResolution,
    dyeResolution,
    densityDissipation,
    velocityDissipation,
    pressure,
    pressureIterations,
    curl,
    splatRadius,
    splatForce,
    shading,
    colorSpeed,
    colorStep,
    colorSaturation,
    colorValue,
    colorIntensity,
    idleMs,
    maxPixelRatio,
  ]);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={className}
      style={{
        opacity,
        ...style,
      }}
    />
  );
};

import React from "react";
import { Sparkles } from "./UiIcon";

export interface PromptChipsProps {
  suggestions: string[];
  onSelect: (prompt: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const PromptChips: React.FC<PromptChipsProps> = ({
  suggestions,
  onSelect,
  className = "",
}) => {
  if (!suggestions || suggestions.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-wrap gap-2 my-3 ${className}`}>
      {suggestions.map((item, idx) => (
        <button
          key={idx}
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onSelect(item)}
          className="group flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-full border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/60 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 shadow-xs hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-700 transition-all text-left"
        >
          <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-500/70 group-hover:text-amber-500 transition-colors flex-shrink-0" />
          <span className="truncate max-w-[280px]">{item}</span>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface PromptTemplate {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  prompt: string;
  tag?: string;
}

export interface PromptTemplateGridProps {
  templates: PromptTemplate[];
  onUse?: (template: PromptTemplate) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const PromptTemplateGrid: React.FC<PromptTemplateGridProps> = ({ templates = [], onUse, className = "" }) => {
  if (templates.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className={`grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 ${className}`}>
      {templates.map((t) => (
        <button
          key={t.id}
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onUse?.(t)}
          className="group flex flex-col text-left p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 hover:border-indigo-300 dark:hover:border-indigo-700 hover:shadow-md transition-all"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 truncate">{t.title}</span>
            {t.tag && (
              <span className="ml-auto px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-medium bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shrink-0">
                {t.tag}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          {t.description && (
            <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 line-clamp-2">{t.description}</div>
          )}
          <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
            <UiIcon name="arrow-right" size={12} />
            Use template
          </div>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};
export default PromptTemplateGrid;

import React from "react";
import { Check, ChevronRight, Lock } from "./UiIcon";

export interface RoadmapNode {
  id: string | number;
  index: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  stageColor?: string;
  status: "completed" | "active" | "locked";
  tags?: string[];
}

export interface RoadmapTimelineProps {
  nodes: RoadmapNode[];
  activeId?: string | number;
  onNodeClick?: (node: RoadmapNode) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const RoadmapTimeline: React.FC<RoadmapTimelineProps> = ({
  nodes,
  activeId,
  onNodeClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  return (
    <div className={`w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto py-8 font-sans ${className}`}>
      <div className="relative flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch justify-between gap-4 md:gap-2">
        {/* 桌面端横向贯穿轨线 */}
        <div className="hidden md:block absolute top-6 left-[4%] right-[4%] h-[2px] bg-[#b3ac97] dark:bg-[#3e444e] -z-0" />
        
        {/* 移动端竖向贯穿轨线 */}
        <div className="md:hidden absolute top-4 bottom-4 left-6 w-[2px] bg-[#b3ac97] dark:bg-[#3e444e] -z-0" />

        {nodes.map((node) => {
          const isCurrentActive = activeId === node.id || node.status === "active";
          const isDone = node.status === "completed";
          const nodeColor = node.stageColor || "#c2410c";

          return (
            <div
              key={node.id}
              onClick={() => onNodeClick?.(node)}
              className={`relative z-10 flex md:flex-col items-center md:items-start gap-4 md:gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 group flex-1 ${
                isCurrentActive
                  ? "bg-[#faf8f1] dark:bg-[#1b1f26] shadow-sm border border-[#b3ac97]/60 dark:border-[#3e444e]"
                  : "hover:bg-[#faf8f1]/50 dark:hover:bg-[#1b1f26]/50"
              }`}
            >
              {/* 菱形地标节点 (Diamond Pin) */}
              <div
                style={{
                  borderColor: isCurrentActive || isDone ? nodeColor : undefined,
                  backgroundColor: isDone ? nodeColor : isCurrentActive ? "#faf8f1" : undefined,
                }}
                className={`w-11 h-11 flex-shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center rotate-45 border-2 rounded-xs transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:scale-105 ${
                  isDone
                    ? "text-white"
                    : isCurrentActive
                    ? "border-2 shadow-xs"
                    : "border-[#b3ac97] dark:border-[#3e444e] bg-[#f1efe7] dark:bg-[#14171c] text-[#8d9298] dark:text-[#6f7268]"
                }`}
              >
                <div className="-rotate-45 font-mono text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center">
                  {isDone ? (
                    <Check className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[3]" />
                  ) : node.status === "locked" ? (
                    <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ color: isCurrentActive ? nodeColor : undefined }}>
                      {node.index}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 文本区域 */}
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span
                    className="font-mono text-xs tracking-wider uppercase font-semibold"
                    style={{ color: nodeColor }}
                  >
                    STEP {node.index}
                  </span>
                  {node.tags && node.tags.length > 0 && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-xs border border-[#d6d2c2] dark:border-[#2b3038] text-[#545b64] dark:text-[#a9a89c]">
                      {node.tags[0]}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <h4
                  className={`mt-1 font-serif text-sm md:text-base font-bold truncate leading-tight ${
                    isCurrentActive
                      ? "text-[#22262d] dark:text-[#e9e6db]"
                      : "text-[#22262d]/80 dark:text-[#e9e6db]/80 group-hover:text-[#22262d] dark:group-hover:text-[#e9e6db]"
                  }`}
                >
                  {node.title}
                </h4>

                {node.subtitle && (
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-[#545b64] dark:text-[#a9a89c] truncate">
                    {node.subtitle}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* 移动端向右箭头 */}
              <div className="md:hidden ml-auto text-[#8d9298]">
                <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { ExternalLink, Globe } from "./UiIcon";

export interface SourceItem {
  id?: string | number;
  title: string;
  url: string;
  snippet?: string;
  siteName?: string;
  favicon?: string;
}

export interface SourcesCitationProps {
  sources: SourceItem[];
  className?: string;
}

export const SourcesCitation: React.FC<SourcesCitationProps> = ({
  sources,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [activeHoverId, setActiveHoverId] = useState<string | number | null>(null);

  if (!sources || sources.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className={`my-3 space-y-2 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        <span>Sources ({sources.length})</span>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
        {sources.map((item, idx) => {
          const indexNum = idx + 1;
          const domain = (() => {
            try {
              return new URL(item.url).hostname.replace("www.", "");
            } catch {
              return item.siteName || "web";
            }
          })();

          return (
            <a
              key={item.id || idx}
              href={item.url}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              onMouseEnter={() => setActiveHoverId(item.id || idx)}
              onMouseLeave={() => setActiveHoverId(null)}
              className="group relative flex flex-col justify-between p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800/80 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/60 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-700 shadow-xs transition-all no-underline"
            >
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 font-mono">
                  <span className="flex items-center justify-center w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 font-bold text-[10px]">
                    {indexNum}
                  </span>
                  <span className="truncate max-w-[120px]">{domain}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 line-clamp-2 leading-snug group-hover:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors">
                  {item.title}
                </div>
              </div>

              {item.snippet && (
                <div className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 line-clamp-2 leading-tight">
                  {item.snippet}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-end text-[10px] text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-zinc-600 dark:group-hover:text-zinc-300">
                <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />
              </div>
            </a>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================
File: react/SpotlightGlareCard.tsx
================================================================

import React, { useRef, useState } from "react";

export interface SpotlightGlareCardProps {
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Glare highlight intensity (0-1), default 0.45 */
  glareOpacity?: number;
  /** Glare gradient radius in percentage, default 55% */
  glareRadius?: number;
  /** Enable subtle 3D tilt transformation */
  enableTilt?: boolean;
  /** Max tilt degrees, default 5 */
  maxTilt?: number;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  onClick?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
}

export const SpotlightGlareCard: React.FC<SpotlightGlareCardProps> = ({
  children,
  glareOpacity = 0.45,
  glareRadius = 55,
  enableTilt = false,
  maxTilt = 5,
  className = "",
  style,
  onClick,
}) => {
  const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const [coords, setCoords] = useState<{ gx: string; gy: string; rx: number; ry: number; isHovered: boolean }>({
    gx: "50%",
    gy: "50%",
    rx: 0,
    ry: 0,
    isHovered: false,
  });

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const card = cardRef.current;
    if (!card) return;
    const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    const gxPercent = (x / rect.width) * 100;
    const gyPercent = (y / rect.height) * 100;

    let rx = 0;
    let ry = 0;
    if (enableTilt) {
      const centerX = rect.width / 2;
      const centerY = rect.height / 2;
      ry = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * maxTilt;
      rx = -((y - centerY) / centerY) * maxTilt;
    }

    setCoords({
      gx: `${gxPercent.toFixed(1)}%`,
      gy: `${gyPercent.toFixed(1)}%`,
      rx,
      ry,
      isHovered: true,
    });
  };

  const handlePointerLeave = () => {
    setCoords((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      rx: 0,
      ry: 0,
      isHovered: false,
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={cardRef}
      onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
      onPointerLeave={handlePointerLeave}
      onClick={onClick}
      style={{
        ...style,
        transform: enableTilt && coords.isHovered
          ? `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${coords.rx}deg) rotateY(${coords.ry}deg) translateY(-2px)`
          : undefined,
        transition: coords.isHovered ? "transform 0.1s ease-out" : "transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)",
      }}
      className={`group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-[#faf8f1] dark:bg-[#1a1d24] border border-[#d6d2c2]/80 dark:border-[#2b3038]/80 text-[#22262d] dark:text-[#e9e6db] shadow-[0_1px_0_rgba(34,38,45,0.07),0_5px_16px_rgba(34,38,45,0.07)] dark:shadow-[0_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.4),0_8px_22px_rgba(0,0,0,0.42)] transition-shadow duration-300 hover:shadow-[0_2px_0_rgba(34,38,45,0.08),0_12px_28px_rgba(34,38,45,0.12)] select-none ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Specular glare reflection layer */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 transition-opacity duration-300"
        style={{
          opacity: coords.isHovered ? glareOpacity : 0,
          background: `radial-gradient(circle at ${coords.gx} ${coords.gy}, rgba(255,255,255,0.85) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 30%, transparent ${glareRadius}%)`,
          mixBlendMode: "overlay",
        }}
      />

      {/* Content wrapper */}
      <div className="relative z-0 h-full w-full">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
};

File: react/StatusIndicator.tsx

import React from "react";

export type StatusType = "online" | "offline" | "busy" | "connecting" | "error";

export interface StatusIndicatorProps {
  status: StatusType;
  label?: string;
  pingMs?: number;
  showDot?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const StatusIndicator: React.FC<StatusIndicatorProps> = ({
  status,
  label,
  pingMs,
  showDot = true,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const getStatusConfig = () => {
    switch (status) {
      case "online":
        return {
          dotBg: "bg-emerald-500",
          pingBg: "bg-emerald-400",
          text: "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400",
          badgeBg: "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-200/80 dark:border-emerald-800/60",
          defaultLabel: "Online",
        };
      case "connecting":
      case "busy":
        return {
          dotBg: "bg-amber-500",
          pingBg: "bg-amber-400",
          text: "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400",
          badgeBg: "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-800/60",
          defaultLabel: status === "busy" ? "Busy" : "Connecting",
        };
      case "error":
      case "offline":
      default:
        return {
          dotBg: "bg-rose-500",
          pingBg: "bg-rose-400",
          text: "text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400",
          badgeBg: "bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800/60",
          defaultLabel: status === "error" ? "Error" : "Offline",
        };
    }
  };

  const config = getStatusConfig();
  const displayLabel = label || config.defaultLabel;

  return (
    <div
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border text-xs font-medium ${config.badgeBg} ${config.text} ${className}`}
    >
      {showDot && (
        <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
          {status === "online" && (
            <span
              className={`animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full opacity-75 ${config.pingBg}`}
            />
          )}
          <span className={`relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 ${config.dotBg}`} />
        </span>
      )}
      <span className="font-semibold">{displayLabel}</span>
      {pingMs !== undefined && (
        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] opacity-75 ml-0.5">
          ({pingMs}ms)
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

File: react/StreamMarkdown.tsx
================================================================

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { marked } from "marked";
import Prism from "prismjs";
import "prismjs/themes/prism-tomorrow.css";
import { Check, Copy } from "./UiIcon";

export interface StreamMarkdownProps {
  content: string;
  isStreaming?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const StreamMarkdown: React.FC<StreamMarkdownProps> = ({
  content,
  isStreaming = false,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Configure marked renderer for syntax highlighting & clean markup
  const htmlContent = useMemo(() => {
    const renderer = new marked.Renderer();

    renderer.code = function ({ text, lang }: { text: string; lang?: string }) {
      const language = lang && Prism.languages[lang] ? lang : "javascript";
      let highlighted = text;
      try {
        if (Prism.languages[language]) {
          highlighted = Prism.highlight(text, Prism.languages[language], language);
        }
      } catch {
        highlighted = text;
      }

      return `
        <div class="relative group my-4 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-1.5 bg-zinc-900/80 border-b border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-400 font-mono">
            <span>${lang || "code"}</span>
            <button 
              type="button" 
              data-code="${encodeURIComponent(text)}" 
              class="copy-btn hover:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
            >
              Copy
            </button>
          </div>
          <pre class="p-4 overflow-x-auto text-sm text-zinc-100 font-mono leading-normal m-0 bg-transparent"><code>${highlighted}</code></pre>
        </div>
      `;
    };

    return marked.parse(content || "", { renderer, breaks: true, gfm: true });
  }, [content]);

  // Delegated safe copy handler (CSP safe, avoids inline onclick)
  const handleContainerClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest(".copy-btn");
    if (!target) return;
    const rawCode = target.getAttribute("data-code");
    if (rawCode) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(decodeURIComponent(rawCode));
      target.textContent = "Copied";
      setTimeout(() => {
        target.textContent = "Copy";
      }, 2000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      onClick={handleContainerClick}
      className={`prose prose-zinc dark:prose-invert max-w-none text-sm leading-relaxed ${className}`}
    >
      <div
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: htmlContent }}
        className="inline-block w-full"
      />
      {isStreaming && (
        <span className="inline-block w-2 h-4 ml-1 -mb-0.5 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 animate-pulse rounded-sm" />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

File: react/StreamingProgressBar.tsx

import React from "react";

export interface StreamingProgressBarProps {
  value?: number | null;
  label?: string;
  status?: "streaming" | "done" | "error";
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS_BAR: Record<string, string> = {
  streaming: "bg-indigo-500",
  done: "bg-emerald-500",
  error: "bg-rose-500",
};

export const StreamingProgressBar: React.FC<StreamingProgressBarProps> = ({
  value = null,
  label,
  status = "streaming",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const clamped = value === null || value === undefined ? null : Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value));
  const indeterminate = clamped === null;
  const barColor = STATUS_BAR[status] || STATUS_BAR.streaming;

  return (
    <div className={`w-full ${className}`}>
      {(label || !indeterminate) && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">
          <span className="truncate">{label}</span>
          {!indeterminate && <span className="tabular-nums shrink-0">{Math.round(clamped)}%</span>}
        </div>
      )}
      <div
        role="progressbar"
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={100}
        aria-valuenow={indeterminate ? undefined : Math.round(clamped)}
        aria-label={label || "Progress"}
        className="h-1 w-full rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden"
      >
        {indeterminate ? (
          <div className={`h-full w-1/3 rounded-full ${barColor} animate-pulse`} />
        ) : (
          <div className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${barColor}`} style={{ width: `${clamped}%` }} />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
export default StreamingProgressBar;

File: react/ThemeToggle.tsx
